articles.title: Split-Second Tragedy on Kanpur–Prayagraj Highway: Truck Driver Crushed Near Toll Plaza
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A brief halt to clean a dusty windshield cost a 50-year-old truck driver his life on the Kanpur–Prayagraj Highway in Fatehpur district. The deceased, Sirajuddin, a resident of Mohalla Masjid Qazi in Shahabad Nagar, Rampur, was transporting goods from Haryana to Kolkata.

body.html:
A brief halt to clean a dusty windshield cost a 50-year-old truck driver his life on the Kanpur–Prayagraj Highway in Fatehpur district.

The deceased, Sirajuddin, a resident of Mohalla Masjid Qazi in Shahabad Nagar, Rampur, was transporting goods from Haryana to Kolkata. The accident occurred near the Katoghan toll plaza in Fatehpur on Thursday.

According to police, Sirajuddin had stopped his truck near the toll plaza after noticing that the windshield was covered with dust. While he was standing in front of the vehicle cleaning it, another truck reportedly pulled up from behind and, due to alleged negligence, pinned him between the two heavy vehicles.

The impact left him critically injured. Bystanders rushed him to a nearby hospital, but doctors declared him dead on arrival.

Police reached the spot soon after receiving information, took custody of the body and sent it for post-mortem. A search has been launched to trace the truck and its driver involved in the incident. Further legal action will follow based on the investigation.

Sirajuddin leaves behind three daughters and a son. His death has plunged his family and neighbourhood into mourning. Locals described him as a hardworking man who had been supporting his family through truck driving for years.

The incident has once again raised concerns over highway safety, especially around busy toll plazas where heavy vehicle movement remains constant. Residents have called for stricter speed regulation and better enforcement of safety norms to prevent such tragedies.

articles.title: Luxury Car Mayhem in Jubilee Hills: Ferrari Rams Multiple Vehicles, Several Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major road accident was reported in Hyderabad after a speeding Ferrari, allegedly driven by businessman Kranti Reddy, lost control and crashed into multiple vehicles in the upscale Jubilee Hills area on Sunday.

body.html:
A major road accident was reported in Hyderabad after a speeding Ferrari, allegedly driven by businessman Kranti Reddy, lost control and crashed into multiple vehicles in the upscale Jubilee Hills area on Sunday.

According to police, the luxury sports car reportedly suffered a brake failure and steering lock, causing it to veer onto the wrong side of the road and ram into several cars and two-wheelers coming from the opposite direction.

The impact caused extensive damage to multiple vehicles, while the Ferrari itself was also severely damaged. A light mast installed in the road median was hit and toppled due to the force of the collision.

Several people sustained injuries in the accident and were shifted to nearby hospitals. Police confirmed that the injured are currently out of danger.

Police teams rushed to the spot immediately after receiving information and initiated traffic clearance operations. Vehicular movement in the area was heavily disrupted, with diversions put in place to manage congestion.

A case has been registered based on a complaint filed by one of the victims. Authorities are investigating the exact cause of the accident. The incident has once again intensified concerns over reckless driving and overspeeding involving luxury vehicles.

articles.title: Hathras: Spit-on-Roti Allegations at Nizam Hotel Spark Outrage, Accused Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Hathras, serious allegations have surfaced regarding food hygiene at Nizam Hotel located in the Madhugarhi area under Sadar Kotwali limits. A video circulating on social media allegedly shows a hotel worker spitting on tandoor rotis before baking them.

body.html:
In Hathras, serious allegations have surfaced regarding food hygiene at Nizam Hotel located in the Madhugarhi area under Sadar Kotwali limits.

A video circulating on social media allegedly shows a hotel worker spitting on tandoor rotis before baking them. The clip quickly went viral, triggering public outrage and raising concerns over customer health and food safety standards.

This is reportedly the second such controversy in the area within a short span. A few days earlier, a similar video from Badshah Hotel in Madhugarhi had drawn attention.

Following the latest viral video, Hathras Police took cognisance of the matter. Officials confirmed that a case has been registered at Kotwali Nagar police station under relevant sections. One accused has been arrested, and legal proceedings are underway as per law.

Residents have demanded a thorough investigation and strict action to prevent recurrence of such incidents. Authorities have assured that appropriate steps will be taken after due inquiry.

articles.title: 60-Year-Old Bihar School Principal Marries 28-Year-Old Teacher in Nepal, Family Alleges Kidnapping
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Muzaffarpur, a 60-year-old private school principal’s marriage to a 28-year-old teacher in Nepal has sparked tension in the locality after wedding photos and videos went viral on social media.

body.html:
In Muzaffarpur, a 60-year-old private school principal’s marriage to a 28-year-old teacher in Nepal has sparked tension in the locality after wedding photos and videos went viral on social media.

According to reports, school owner and principal Rakesh Sah, who is said to be the father of four children, married Shaista Parveen, a teacher at his own school, in Janakpur on February 18.

Following the marriage, Shaista’s brother lodged a complaint at Aurai police station, alleging that his sister had been kidnapped and forced into marriage. The complaint reportedly names seven individuals, including Rakesh Sah, his wife and daughter. He also expressed apprehension about her safety.

However, in a video circulated online, Shaista Parveen claimed that she married of her own free will. She stated that she is safe and not under any pressure, adding that the marriage was conducted with mutual consent.

With tension prevailing in the village and concerns over possible communal strain, police have intensified the investigation. Aurai Police Station Officer Ranwar Parveen said that mobile phones of three named accused have been seized and call detail records are being analysed. Officials stated that it is yet to be determined whether the case involves a consensual marriage or coercion, and the truth will emerge after a thorough probe.

The episode has reminded many of the 2006 controversy involving Matuknath Choudhary, a Hindi professor at Patna University, who made national headlines after marrying his student Julie despite public protests and subsequent suspension.

#Muzaffarpur #BiharNews #NepalMarriage #ViralVideo #PoliceInvestigation #Controversy #BreakingNews

articles.title: Drunk Youth Vandalises Temple in Raebareli, Shivling Damaged; Arrested After CCTV Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An incident of vandalism at a religious site has surfaced from Raebareli district of Uttar Pradesh, where a youth allegedly entered a temple in an inebriated state and damaged religious symbols.

body.html:
An incident of vandalism at a religious site has surfaced from Raebareli district of Uttar Pradesh, where a youth allegedly entered a temple in an inebriated state and damaged religious symbols.

The incident took place at the Gaurishankar Temple in Hamidpur Badagaon under the Unchahar Kotwali area. According to local residents, the accused, identified as Kuldeep Yadav from Nandi Ka Purwa village, entered the temple premises late at night and allegedly began vandalising items inside.

Villagers claimed that he broke a trident (trishul) kept in the temple and repeatedly struck the Shivling before fleeing. By the time locals intervened, significant damage had reportedly been caused.

The entire episode was captured on CCTV cameras installed at the temple. The footage later surfaced on social media and went viral, prompting swift police action.

Unchahar police took cognisance of the matter and arrested the accused. Officials confirmed that a case has been registered and strict legal action will follow. Police said all angles are being investigated.

The incident has triggered anger among residents, who have demanded enhanced security at religious places.

articles.title: Shocking! Hotel Staff Caught Spitting on Rotis in Aligarh, Arrested After Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident has come to light in Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh, where a hotel employee was allegedly caught on camera spitting on rotis before serving them to customers. The incident occurred on Saturday night in the Rorawar police station area.

body.html:
A disturbing incident has come to light in Uttar Pradesh’s Aligarh, where a hotel employee was allegedly caught on camera spitting on rotis before serving them to customers.

The incident occurred on Saturday night in the Rorawar police station area. Two six-second videos, reportedly recorded by a customer, surfaced on February 21, showing a hotel worker bending over rotis and allegedly spitting on them before placing them on the flame.

The hotel, identified as Sadab Chicken Darbar in the Shahjamal area, was immediately brought under scrutiny after the videos went viral. According to eyewitnesses, customers confronted the staff member, identified as Suhail, who initially denied the allegation. An argument followed, and police along with Food Department officials were informed.

Teams reached the spot, collected food samples for laboratory testing, and gathered statements from people present. Amid public outrage and demands for strict action, police arrested the accused and seized the hotel premises.

Circle Officer Kamlesh Kumar confirmed that an FIR has been registered against the employee. Samples have been sent for testing, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Tilak Ceremony Turns Violent in Rae Bareli After 8-Year Affair Allegation Surfaces
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A fierce clash broke out during a Tilak ceremony in the Harchandpur police station area of Rae Bareli on Saturday night, leaving around half a dozen people injured. The incident occurred in Purva Nayab Ka Purwa under Mohammadpur Dighora Gram Panchayat.

body.html:
A fierce clash broke out during a Tilak ceremony in the Harchandpur police station area of Rae Bareli on Saturday night, leaving around half a dozen people injured.

The incident occurred in Purva Nayab Ka Purwa under Mohammadpur Dighora Gram Panchayat. According to reports, the Tilak ceremony of Aman, son of Muneshwar, was underway when members of the bride’s family allegedly learned that Aman had been in a relationship with another woman for the past eight years.

Sources said the bride’s side contacted the woman, who reportedly confirmed the long-term relationship and claimed that both families were aware of it. She alleged that Aman had promised to marry her and that her marriage had earlier been arranged elsewhere in September 2023 by Aman's family.

The woman stated that after she lodged a written complaint at Harchandpur police station, Aman and his family assured her that they would marry her in 2024 following proper rituals. However, a few months ago, Aman's family reportedly fixed his marriage with another woman from Korihar village.

After the bride’s family came to know about the alleged affair, they cancelled the Tilak ceremony. Following the cancellation, a heated argument escalated into a physical clash between Aman's family and the woman’s family.

Around six people from the woman’s side were injured in the scuffle and have received treatment. The woman has filed a complaint at Harchandpur police station seeking action against Aman.

Police have registered a case and initiated further investigation into the matter.

articles.title: Wedding Celebrations Turn Tragic in Bulandshahr: 8-Year-Old Shot During Celebratory Firing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A wedding celebration in Bulandshahr turned into a horrific incident after a bullet fired during celebratory firing struck an eight-year-old boy, leaving him critically injured and in a coma.

body.html:
A wedding celebration in Bulandshahr turned into a horrific incident after a bullet fired during celebratory firing struck an eight-year-old boy, leaving him critically injured and in a coma.

The incident took place around 5:30 pm on February 19 in Sheikh Sarai Mohalla, located about 1.5 km from the district headquarters under the City Kotwali police station area. Reyansh Soni, son of Himanshu Soni, was playing on the rooftop of his house when a bullet pierced his jaw during aerial firing at a neighbour’s wedding.

According to police, Vinod alias Rinku Soni was celebrating his daughter’s wedding on February 20. On February 19, family members were dancing outside their house when Vinod’s 16-year-old son brought out a licensed pistol and fired into the air. Though some relatives objected, Vinod allegedly encouraged him, saying, “You fire. If anyone gets shot, I’ll take care of it.”

Despite warnings that the lane was narrow and people were on rooftops, the minor reportedly roamed the street firing multiple rounds. One of the bullets struck Reyansh, who collapsed on the terrace, bleeding profusely.

Hearing screams, Reyansh’s father rushed out and carried him in his arms to a nearby hospital. He was later referred to Noida and admitted to Fortis Hospital Noida, where doctors operated on him for nearly four hours. His skull bone had to be removed during surgery. The child is currently on ventilator support and remains in a coma. Doctors have termed the next 48 hours as critical.

Two videos of the incident have surfaced. In one, the minor is seen firing repeatedly while relatives dance nearby. In another clip, the father is also seen engaging in celebratory firing.

Police have registered a case based on the complaint filed by Reyansh’s father. CO City Prakhar Pandey said CCTV footage and video evidence have been collected, and the licensed weapon has been seized. The accused minor and his father are absconding, and police teams are conducting raids to arrest them.

The victim’s family has demanded strict action, including cancellation of the arms licence, and alleged that police initially allowed the accused time to complete the wedding rituals before taking action.

Reyansh is the only child of the family. His mother remains inconsolable as the family waits anxiously for updates on his condition.

articles.title: Badaun: Man Arrested After Viral Video Shows Assault on Three Men | UP News
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing three men being allegedly assaulted in Badaun district of Uttar Pradesh has surfaced on social media, triggering outrage and political reactions. The incident reportedly took place on February 15 in Rudayan town, around four kilometres from Sahaswan.

body.html:
A video showing three men being allegedly assaulted in Badaun district of Uttar Pradesh has surfaced on social media, triggering outrage and political reactions.

The incident reportedly took place on February 15 in Rudayan town, around four kilometres from Sahaswan. The video came to light on February 20.

According to Armaan, brother of victim Javed, the three men — Javed, Arif and Abdul Salam — work as grave diggers and beg for alms during Ramzan when work is scarce. They had gone to a locality in Rudayan and asked a man on a scooter for directions to a Muslim-majority area and the highway.

Armaan alleged that the scooter rider, identified as Akshay, became enraged upon hearing the query. He allegedly stopped his vehicle, questioned their presence and began assaulting them. The victims claimed they were slapped, abused, chased for nearly 200 metres and forced out of the street. It is also alleged that one of the elderly men was made to remove his cap during the assault.

In the viral video, the accused is seen allegedly beating the three men while two others record the incident.

Following circulation of the footage, police registered a case based on a complaint by Abdul Salam. The accused, Akshay, has been arrested and sent to jail. Further investigation is underway.

The incident has drawn political reactions, with the Indian National Congress criticising the Uttar Pradesh government over law and order and alleged rising intolerance. The party posted on social media condemning the attack and termed it an example of growing hostility in society.

Police have not yet issued a detailed public statement on the motive. Authorities said action was taken promptly after the video surfaced.
